{"lean_source":"structure Input where
  n : Int
  edges : List (List Int)

def Conforms (input : Input) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ input.n ∧ input.n ≤ 10 ∧
  ∀ edge ∈ input.edges, ∃ u v : Int,
    edge = [u, v] ∧ 0 ≤ u ∧ u < input.n ∧ 0 ≤ v ∧ v < input.n

abbrev Output := Option (List (List Int))

theorem conforms_nonempty : ∃ input : Input, Conforms input := by
  exact ⟨⟨0, []⟩, by simp [Conforms]⟩
